test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In what ratio should sugar costing ₹45 per kg be mixed with sugar costing ₹52 per kg so that by selling the mixture at ₹55.20 per kg, there is a profit of 15%?
solution:
Given - 

Sugar costing Rs. 45 per kg be mixed with sugar costing Rs. 52 per kg

Profit = 15%, selling price = Rs. 55.20

Formula used - 

Selling price = (100 + profit) × cost price/100

Solution - 

Let the cost price of the whole mixture be Rs. x.

⇒ x = 55.2 × 100/115

⇒ x = Rs. 48 

Ratio = (52 – 48) ∶ (48 – 45)

⇒ 4 ∶ 3

∴ The ratio is 4 : 3.
